title: Evidence-gated ExtremeCraft fifteen-chunk regeneration raid objective

objective.buffer_depth_evidence: field-reported and community-repeated; reverify for the current map

conditional_modules.scatter: Use only after lane control is proven and the measured defense needs broader target coverage.
conditional_modules.double-tap: Use only when two distinct target interactions are required by the measured defense course.
conditional_modules.reverse: Use only when the target geometry requires a vertical-then-directed path and field restrictions are verified.
conditional_modules.left-right-shot: Use only when a measured turn is required and the server threshold/rule profile is verified.
conditional_modules.osrb: Use only with a source-defined ratio and isolated clip/restack evidence.
conditional_modules.nuke: Use only after lineup, hybrid fusion, survival and server-rule compliance are already proven.
